evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies NAT traversal protocol code (PCP and NAT-PMP fallback) used for node connectivity in src/common/pcp.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a minor error-handling bug where 16-bit error codes ending in byte 1 are falsely recognized as unsupported-version responses during gateway protocol fallback. As noted in the description, RFC 6886 section 3.5 specifies that result codes are 16-bit values, whereas the fallback check was reading only a single byte at the wrong offset. This is a real correctness fix for router interoperability, though reasonably deferrable given the narrow edge case.
